# PR-001 PO Approval Matrix

## 1. Scope

Applies to every purchase order raised by Meridian buyers.

## 2. Approval thresholds

### 2.1 Standard purchase orders

Purchase orders up to $10,000 are approved by the Procurement Lead. Orders above $10,000 and up to $50,000 need the Finance Director.

### 2.2 Emergency purchase orders

Emergency orders may be released by the on-call manager and must be ratified within two business days.
